_comment: Opponent ladder for 9x9, Chinese rules, komi 7.5. 'elo' values were measured with `python -m goarena calibrate --games 12 --span 2` (anchor random = 0, Bradley-Terry fit); 'elo_se' is the standard error. KataGo levels mix uniformly random moves into KataGo's raw policy (no search) so their strength does not depend on hardware; lv8/max use a fixed visit count. 'max' was not calibrated and is unrated. Network: g170e-b10c128 (bundled with the KataGo repo). Re-calibrate if you change the network.

random.label: Random
random.description: uniform random legal move (never fills its own eyes)

greedy.label: Greedy
greedy.description: one-ply tactics: capture, escape atari, avoid self-atari; no search

lv7.label: KataGo level 7
lv7.description: KataGo raw policy, no search, no random moves

lv8.label: KataGo level 8
lv8.description: KataGo with a small search (32 visits)

max.label: KataGo max
max.description: KataGo with a full search (600 visits); not counted in the rating
